# Tester — Progress Memory

> **This file is the agent's persistent memory.** The `Tester` agent
> (`.github/agents/tester.agent.md`) MUST read this at session start and update it at session
> end. Keep it accurate and current. Commit it together with the work it describes.

## Mission

Verify that the Coder's implementation of each changelog feature compiles cleanly and behaves
correctly. The tester does NOT write code — it runs the build, the smoke test, and the
acceptance checks, and reports a clear pass/fail.

**1.100-16.S2** (2026-10-23) — **FAIL** (criterion 5a). Client/manager inputs plumbing in `src/mcp.ts` + `src/mcpManager.ts` (commit dbad249). Build exit 0; smoke 766/766 (no new guards this slice). Scope clean: `git show --stat dbad249` touches only `src/mcp.ts` (+11/-2), `src/mcpManager.ts` (+46/-3) + coder PROGRESS.md; `ninfer` submodule NOT committed. Passing criteria: (1) compile clean; (2) smoke 766/766; (3) `McpClient` ctor optional 2nd arg `inputs?` — non-empty inputs -> `resolveMcpInputs(config, inputs)` for spawn env, empty/absent -> byte-identical old env (verified via spawn monkey-patch probe: 6/6 env assertions — resolved value, passthrough, process.env inheritance, byte-identical no-inputs/empty-inputs/no-env cases); (4) manager plumbing — `private inputs = new Map<string, Record<string, string>>()`, `setInputs` stores / empty-object deletes, `setServers` drops inputs for removed servers, `ensureStarted` passes `this.inputs.get(name)` into `new McpClient(cfg, ...)`, HTTP path `new McpHttpClient(cfg)` unchanged, ctor-throw catch sets error status + `notify('MCP server '<name>' failed to start: <message>')` + clears `starting` + rethrows (all verified in code + probe: setInputs store/clear, setServers drop, HTTP path ignores inputs); (5a) **BUG**: `ensureStarted` WITHOUT `setInputs` does NOT reject with `missing required input: API_KEY`. Runtime probe (real command `node -e setTimeout`, env `{ API_KEY: '${input:API_KEY}' }`): rejection message is `McpJsonRpc closed` (handshake failure), status error `McpJsonRpc closed`, notify `MCP server 'srv' failed to start: McpJsonRpc closed`. Root cause: `McpClient` constructor (src/mcp.ts ~line 369) only calls `resolveMcpInputs(config, inputs)` when `inputs && Object.keys(inputs).length > 0`; with no `setInputs` the manager passes `undefined` -> old path -> env keeps the literal `${input:API_KEY}` string -> spawn succeeds -> handshake fails with `McpJsonRpc closed` instead of the required `missing required input: API_KEY`. **Fix for Coder:** always run `resolveMcpInputs(config, inputs ?? {})` at construction (it throws on missing refs even with empty provided map, and returns `{ ...config.env }` unchanged when no `${input:...}` refs exist — preserving the byte-identical env for input-free configs); keep the manager catch block as-is. (5b) with `setInputs(name, { API_KEY: 'v' })` first, construction proceeds past input resolution (probe: rejection is ENOENT/handshake error, NOT `missing required input` — PASS); (5c) `setInputs(name, {})` clears the entry (probe PASS). **Next: Coder fix, then re-verify 1.100-16.S2.**

Passing criteria: `newDiagnostics` imported from `src/tools/ToolExecutor.ts` (line 56); `MAX_AUTOFIX_ROUNDS = 2` named constant (line 86); new diags + `settings.agentAutoFix` + `autoFixRounds < MAX_AUTOFIX_ROUNDS` → system message "New problems appeared in … Fix them." + delta note + counter increment + loop continues (lines 1663-1678); past cap → delta note only, loop proceeds (else branch); `autoFixRounds` reset at run start right after `clearChangeSummary()` (line 1453); loop terminates (cap 2 + outer `MAX_TOOL_ITERATIONS = 8`). **BUG:** the "before" diagnostics snapshot is taken AFTER the tool batch executes, not before. Batch runs at line 1505 (`for (const call of toolCalls)`); `const before = this.autofixSnapshot(editedPaths)` is at line 1659, then 500 ms settle, then `after` at line 1662. Only two `autofixSnapshot` calls exist (1659, 1662). Consequence: the diff misses diagnostics introduced by the edits themselves — it only catches ones appearing in the 500 ms window after the post-batch snapshot, so the autofix hook effectively never fires for the intended case. **Fix for Coder:** move the `before` snapshot to before the batch loop (i.e. before line 1505, after `editedPaths` is computed from `toolCalls`), keep the 500 ms settle + `after` snapshot where they are.

## Verification commands

- **Compile:** `npm run compile` (must exit 0, no errors)
- **Smoke test:** `node scripts/smoke-test.js` (must pass all assertions)
- **Lint (optional):** `npm run lint`

## Notes / decisions

- The tester does NOT write code. If a bug is found, report it (exact error, file, line) so
  the Coder can fix it.
- Always run the build first. If it fails, report fail immediately.
- Always run the smoke test. Record the assertion count.
- Report, don't fix.

## Verification commands

- **Compile:** `npm run compile` (must exit 0, no errors)
- **Smoke test:** `node scripts/smoke-test.js` (must pass all assertions)
- **Lint (optional):** `npm run lint`

## Notes / decisions

- The tester does NOT write code. If a bug is found, report it (exact error, file, line) so
  the Coder can fix it.
- Always run the build first. If it fails, report fail immediately.
- Always run the smoke test. Record the assertion count.
- Report, don't fix.
